title: probavi-manifest/1 — a backup tool's statement about what it wrote
description: One JSON file written beside a backup at backup time and named by target.source.manifest. The core reads it before the sandbox is created and refuses the drill when the artifact disagrees. Normative document: ../../backup-manifest.md. Note that expected_checksum is computed under the rule in that document's §3 and is NOT the adapter-defined backup.checksum an evidence record carries: the two answer different questions and are not comparable (§4).

schema.description: Pins the shape. Required; an absent or unknown value is a configuration error, not a manifest to guess at.

expected_checksum.description: The artifact's digest under backup-manifest.md §3: SHA-256 over a regular file's bytes, or the canonical tree hash for a directory. Not the adapter's backup.checksum.

expected_size_bytes.description: A regular file's size, or the sum of every regular file's size in a directory.

created_at.description: When the backup job says it produced the artifact. Informational: it is the backup tool's claim, and never populates the record's backup.created_at, which is the adapter's measurement of the artifact itself.

engine_version.description: Informational. Version compatibility is enforced by the adapter, from the artifact, not from this file.
